name: qlib-sync
description: Install, update, and read a local Qlib China A-share daily dataset.
long_description: Keeps ~/.qlib/qlib_data/cn_data current with the daily community release from chenditc/investment_data, with checksum verification and automatic rollback, and lets Claude read daily prices and index constituents from it. The first update downloads about 550 MB.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where the A-share dataset lives. Qlib reads ~/.qlib/qlib_data/cn_data by default.

mirror.title: Download mirror (optional)
mirror.description: Prefix-style GitHub proxy for slow connections, e.g. https://ghfast.top. Leave empty to download from GitHub.

tools.name: cn_status
tools.description: Local latest date, pools, and whether an update is available

tools.name: cn_update
tools.description: Install or update the dataset; restores the previous data on failure

tools.name: cn_health_check
tools.description: Structure checks plus a real Qlib read

tools.name: cn_get_prices
tools.description: Daily bars for up to 20 symbols, real or adjusted prices

tools.name: cn_list_pool
tools.description: Members of csi300, csi500, and other pools on a date
